definitions.explanation: An item of the highest grade or quality. Can refer to physical products or, figuratively, to skills or abilities of outstanding caliber.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一級品|いっきゅうひん}だ。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一級品|いっきゅうひん}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧だ。
examples.english: His skill is said to be first-rate.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一級品|いっきゅうひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}している→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant serves dishes made only with first-class ingredients.

notes:
USAGE:
{一級品|いっきゅうひん} literally means "first-grade product" and is used to describe something of the highest quality. It can describe physical goods (leather, fabric, ingredients) or be used figuratively for skills and abilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一級品|いっきゅうひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧ (first-class materials)
- {一級品|いっきゅうひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ (first-class flavor)
- ⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一級品|いっきゅうひん} (top-notch skill)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{最高級|さいこうきゅう}→最高級：20276_saikoukyuu⟧ means "highest grade" and is often used for luxury goods with formal marketing language. ⟦{一流|いちりゅう}→一流：03009_ichiryuu⟧ (first-rate) is broader and describes people, establishments, or quality in general. {一級品|いっきゅうひん} focuses specifically on the item or product itself.
